title: Which way to run the SQL workload does the question want?

questions.ask: Global users, JSON whose shape changes often, writes in several regions?
questions.yes: Azure Cosmos DB, not SQL Server

questions.ask: Needs FILESTREAM, an agent on the server's OS, a specific older version or update control?
Needs SQL Server Agent, cross-database queries, CLR or linked servers, with no OS to patch?

otherwise: Azure SQL Database: serverless, elastic pools or Hyperscale as the stem asks
caption: Go down the ladder only as far as a named feature forces you; the first yes decides.
